sources.name: Original Turtle Rules, System 2
sources.decision: Admitted to a daily-close historical Freqtrade adaptation. Exact adaptation differences documented in protocol.json.

sources.name: Price Transmission from Bitcoin to Altcoins
sources.mechanism: One-minute BTC and altcoin log returns feed separate entry and hold classifiers to trade delayed response.
sources.decision: Source hypothesis retained. No account admitted. None of the five traded paper coins is in the frozen 40-perpetual cohort. Its 1-minute signal is outside the pinned data resolution; source reports that most effects were very small or absent at 2–3 minutes. A 5-minute interpretation would be a different hypothesis.

sources.name: Systematic Cryptocurrency Research
sources.mechanism: Compare volatility-normalized trend with reversals following extreme BTC quote-volume share.
sources.decision: Source review only. Cost-restated 263-day results were +9.54% for trend and -6.96% for the reversal rule. Trend allocated approximately 77.5% of mean gross exposure to BTC. The source's accounts are separate from the frozen Binance 40-perpetual comparison.

sources.name: CTA components in crypto perpetuals
sources.mechanism: Volatility-normalized EMA trends, inverse volatility weights, correlation grouping and a no-rebalance band.
sources.decision: Use as an implementation reference. Published inverse-volatility ablation supported a risk-sizing contribution. Source model draws on a wider universe and permits 2x gross; its performance is outside the current 1x account comparison.

sources.name: CTREND and the 2026 reproduction audit
sources.decision: Original result depends on portfolio definitions and signal timing. Published corrected full-universe low-cost mean is -0.87% per week with no ex-post asset removal. Restricted asset-level inputs and economic settlement required for a full replication. Keep public summary verification separate from Freqtrade performance.
